title: UPSC CSE - Quantitative Ability - Simple Interest Compound Interest
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: A principal P becomes Q in 1 year when compounded half-yearly with R annual rate of interest. If the same principal P becomes Q in 1 year when compounded annually with 8% annual rate of interest, then which one of the following is correct?
